an 5.4.40 sālandana sutta monks, the great sāla trees, supported by the himalaya, the king of mountains, grow in five growths.

what five? they grow in branches, leaves, and foliage; they grow in bark, shoots, and pith; they grow in heartwood. monks, the great sāla trees, supported by the himalaya, the king of mountains, grow in these five growths.

even so, monks, folk within a home, supported by a believing clan chief, grow in five growths. what five? they grow in faith, in virtue, in learning, in generosity, and they grow in wisdom. monks, folk within the home, supported by a believing clan chief, grow in these five growths.
